1. Always maintain tasks.md in the root of the repository. This file should contain a list of all tasks that need to be completed for the project, along with their status (e.g., "To Do", "In Progress", "Done").
2. Use the following format for each task in tasks.md:
   - [ ] Task description (To Do)
   - [x] Task description (Done)
   - [ ] Task description (In Progress)
3. Update tasks.md regularly to reflect the current status of each task. This will help keep everyone on the same page and ensure that all tasks are tracked effectively.
4. When a task is completed, mark it as done by changing the status to "Done" and updating the checkbox to [x].
5. If a task is in progress, update the status to "In Progress" and keep the checkbox as [ ] until it is completed.
6. Use clear and concise descriptions for each task to ensure that everyone understands what needs to be done. Avoid using vague or ambiguous language.
7. Prioritize tasks based on their importance and urgency. This will help ensure that critical tasks are completed first and that the project stays on track.
8. Regularly review and update the tasks in tasks.md to ensure that they are still relevant and that any new tasks are added as needed. This will help keep the project organized and ensure that all necessary work is accounted for.
